description: MeSH-anchored indication registry. Stable ids used as FKs from disease-insights manifests, keyword cluster files, and the lexicon. The single source of truth — keyword_lexicon.json no longer carries its own meta.indications.

items.label: Lupus Nephritis
items.description: Kidney manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Spans induction/maintenance immunosuppression, renal labs, and progression to CKD/ESRD.

items.label: Melanoma
items.description: Cutaneous and metastatic melanoma. Spans surgical excision, immunotherapy (anti-PD-1, anti-CTLA-4), targeted therapy (BRAF/MEK), and surveillance.

items.label: Obesity
items.description: GLP-1 weight-management corpus (WCT GLP-1 interviews). Metabolic comorbidities (diabetes, PCOS, sleep apnea) sit under this indication as comorbidities.

items.label: Multiple Sclerosis
items.description: Autoimmune demyelinating disease of the CNS. Spans the disease-modifying therapy (DMT) landscape (anti-CD20, S1P modulators, fumarates, alpha-4 integrin, interferon-betas), MRI-based monitoring, EDSS-based disability tracking, and disease courses (RRMS, SPMS, PPMS). CAR-T programs targeting CD19+ B cells (e.g., KYV-101, Descartes-08) are in development for refractory / progressive MS.

items.label: Phenylketonuria
items.description: Inborn error of phenylalanine metabolism caused by phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) deficiency. Lifetime management centers on Phe-restricted diet plus medical foods, with pharmacotherapy via sapropterin (Kuvan) for BH4-responsive patients, pegvaliase (Palynziq) for adults with uncontrolled Phe, and sepiapterin (Sephience, PTC) added in 2024-25. Newborn screening (Guthrie / heel-prick) detects nearly all US cases at birth; downstream burden spans neurocognitive effects of elevated Phe, mood/executive-function impacts, maternal PKU syndrome, and lost-to-follow-up adults returning to care.

items.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
items.description: Systemic autoimmune disease centered on lymphocytic infiltration of exocrine glands (lacrimal, salivary) causing sicca complex plus extraglandular involvement — fatigue, arthralgia, peripheral / small-fiber / autonomic neuropathy, interstitial lung disease, renal tubular acidosis, cryoglobulinemia, vasculitis, and elevated MALT lymphoma risk. Diagnosis anchored on anti-Ro/SSA + anti-La/SSB serology and lip biopsy (focus score). Scope here is primary Sjögren's, full systemic. Therapeutic landscape historically thin (HCQ, secretagogues, off-label immunosuppressants); active Ph3 / Ph2 pipeline includes ianalumab (Novartis), dazodalibep (Amgen), nipocalimab (J&J), tibulizumab (Lilly), iscalimab (Novartis).

items.label: IgA Nephropathy
items.description: Most common primary glomerulonephritis worldwide, driven by mesangial deposition of galactose-deficient IgA1 immune complexes. Classically presents in young adults with synpharyngitic gross hematuria or asymptomatic micro-hematuria + proteinuria found on routine urinalysis; biopsy graded by Oxford MEST-C. Therapeutic landscape shifted dramatically 2021-25 with the approvals of budesonide-ER (Tarpeyo), sparsentan (Filspari), iptacopan (Fabhalta), and atrasentan (Vanrafia) on top of the RASi + SGLT2i backbone; Ph3 pipeline includes APRIL/BLyS inhibitors (sibeprenlimab, atacicept, zigakibart, povetacicept) and complement-pathway agents.
